doc: Canonical golden-frame cases for /ws/reader-sync (#210). Every implementation adapter drives its in-process session core through `steps` and must emit the exact frame sequence in each `expect`. Dynamic values use @bindings harvested from received frames: @<link>.link, @<link>.member, @<link>.token, @session, @code, @digest, @leader.member, @follower.member, @manifest.canonical (canonical JSON text of the case's resolver manifest; single-chunk cases only). Ops: link/send/expect/drain/detach/tick. Every client request carries the full request envelope {v, requestId, sessionId, workEpoch, baseRevision, type, payload} — lifecycle ops use sessionId:null workEpoch:0 baseRevision:0. requestIds must be unique within a case: .member/.token bindings resolve the sending link by requestId alone, so a second link reusing an id mis-attributes. tick is currently py-adapter-only — the rs adapter panics on it (real-clock core), so cases must not use it until both sides implement it.

cases.title: CREATE -> code ACK -> JOIN -> pending -> APPROVE -> paired selecting
OPEN_WORK -> loading -> MANIFEST chunks -> READY x2 -> reading
reading: leader TURN rev7 + follower GOTO rev8
resend replays ACK; stale revision/epoch -> REJECT + snapshot
both up -> webrtc-dc (STATE rev7 + TRANSPORT_STATE), one down -> back
detach -> paused/offline; RESUME -> manifest unicast -> READY -> reading
LEAVE -> END(reason=left) to every member, no ACK
bad code / malformed / not_paired / no_pending REJECTs
member-drive capability: follower member OPEN_WORK direct is accepted
member-drive capability: leader may relay follower OPEN_WORK; origin owns the response
guest trust is immutable: direct and member-leader-relayed OPEN_WORK both reject
payload.origin is whitelisted to sequenced data-plane ops only
shared browse: either member opens/closes; duplicate opens idempotent; suspend is not close
shared browse: peer may close even while opener is offline; resume observes closed state
shared browse: a committed OPEN_WORK ends selecting even without endBrowse
bootstrap auto:true is stale once a deliberate non-auto load has committed
RESUME requires stored member trust to match the link authentication class
post-commit resend of the triggering OPEN_WORK replays its ACK without re-loading
follower cannot use payload.origin leader on sequenced ops
